data.name: Renters Revenge
data.detailed_description:
Renters have gone mad and they are coming to kill you. And why would they want to do that? Haven’t you always been a fair LANDLORD? Ah…nope! So call it justice, call it a cruel taste of revenge, or maybe just a terrible nightmare. Either way your life hangs by a thread. So survive if you can as wave after wave of killer renters try to destroy you with extreme prejudice.

Here’s what you get:
• Psychotic Renters -- Tons of vicious crazed renter enemies coming in hordes to destroy you! Some are even supersized!
• Guns Galore – Blast away with a pistol, shotgun, or golden Ak-47
• It’s a Renter Zoo out there – A fully-virtual world with new levels on the way
• Easter Eggs – explore the level to find secret vantage points
• Aggression Displacement -- Relive your latent cruelty by slaughtering renters

reviews.review:
My god, where to begin.  First off, this is bizarre.  Although the store page might lead you believe there is some plot, within the game there is nothing of the kind.  You're kind of just plunked down on a city street and you soon begin to be attacked by zombies.  You start with two pistols, but there are some AK-47s and shotguns that can be found on a random table on a street corner.  These seem to run out of ammo after a bit and become useless--or maybe I'm doing something wrong.  The pistols do reload when dropped to your waist.  Sometimes I'd accidentally drop a pistol...I can't decide whether that's a bug or a feature because you're then forced to try and get back to the dropped weapon to pick up.

And then a giant woman with questionable underwear runs out.  It seems the more you shoot the zombies, the more of them spawn.  And then more giants appear.  I have no idea what the giants are for (they don't attack you).  

There is little variety in zombies.  There is very little audio within the game (upon release)...sometimes just a random word that might be "metal" gets blurted out for no reason.  There are two statues of Vladimir Lenin on the street, but the signs are English.  I didn't know what was going on but it was strangely compelling.

Look, this is a free game.  It's bonkers.  Just download it and try it.  Who can complain about "free?"  Plus, you get to see a bunch of giants run down the street then stand over you and show you their sketchy underwear.
